dedupe_keys.name: number of beds in government hospitals by hospital

description: Number of Beds in Government Hospitals by Hospital is a series of data sets listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset provides information on the number of beds available in government hospitals in Qatar, categorized by hospital name, for the years 2014 to 2025. Each row represents the number of beds in a specific government hospital during a given year. Coverage: Qatar. The portal lists 3 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are beds, hospitals, government, government hospitals, qatar. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
